# Synthetic calibration exercises

These are invented boundary cases for discussing the candidate anchors. They are NOT real student work, trial results, whole-project exemplars or evidence of independent moderation. Mark independently before reading the proposed rationale in calibration-rationales.md. Only the listed points can be judged; all other marks remain unknown.
